title: Classroom — Teacher View
attribution: Christophe Seux — CC0; derived cameras and source-prop composition
method: Seven individually rendered positions. XYZ selects an actual source camera; pan and focal length reframe that image. No invented continuous physical camera translation.

camera.name: Capture_Teacher
camera.sourceClippingMethod: Explicit near plane on the derived source camera; unchanged across the bounded rig.

radianceCapture.denoising: OpenImageDenoise HIGH/ACCURATE; full-frame with albedo and normal guides

independentBaseCapture.note: Retained raw capture only; delivered center base instead comes from the same 256spp EXR as detail.

views.baseRadianceMethod: Area-average the exact center detail EXR in scene-linear space; no separate 32spp image at initial load.

detail.method: One independently rendered source perspective camera, with source-owned geometry/materials/lights.

camera.name: Capture_Teacher
camera.sourceClippingMethod: Explicit near plane on the derived source camera; unchanged across the bounded rig.

derivations.illumination: Original non-camera world and emitter unchanged
derivations.depth: Background remains infinity; no new occluding geometry

sourceProvenance.sourceGeometryLighting: Original furniture, room, materials and light parameters unchanged; new source-prop copies and camera-only world documented.

bakedSourceDerivations.illumination: Original non-camera world and emitter unchanged
bakedSourceDerivations.depth: Background remains infinity; no new occluding geometry

detail.samplingPolicy: center 256 spp at 5120 px; six neighboring captures 32 spp at 4096 px

detailDepth.method: One-sample source Cycles axial-Z at exactly matching radiance matrices and near planes.

flash.method: Cycles isolated CameraFlash light group, full-frame OIDN with normal/albedo guides; no ambient subtraction.
flash.position: actual capture camera origin plus explicit forward offset

defaultsEvidence.focus: Source axial-Z teaching subject: foreground books, window-side chair, or mid-room desk row respectively.
defaultsEvidence.baseEV: Same original classroom lighting; new background sky branch is camera-only, not an illumination change.

derivations.illumination: Original non-camera world and emitter unchanged
derivations.depth: Background remains infinity; no new occluding geometry

sourceProvenance.sourceGeometryLighting: Original furniture, room, materials and light parameters unchanged; new source-prop copies and camera-only world documented.

base.centerMethod: Area-average the matching 5120px/256spp scene-linear EXR before log2 encoding
